findings.summary: Official menu provides ingredient descriptions and V/G dietary markers but no complete allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure; inferred negatives are not supportable.

Current official menu contains additional food and nonalcoholic products not present in the frozen 26-item baseline, including marinated cucumbers, pan con tomate, jamon serrano croquetas, stuffed dates, beef kebab, fried calamari, dips, desserts, and nonalcoholic cocktails.

The homepage describes brunch products but does not expose a fully enumerable brunch surface; Barca Breakfast, Breakfast Croquetas, and Spanish Tortilla could not be confirmed as current products from the accessible menu block.
OpenTable menu corroborates official all-day food content and reports a May 2026 update; it is third-party corroboration only.

scout.summary: BARCA identity and current official menu surfaces are discoverable. The official homepage exposes an all-day food menu, Pier Beverage Menu, Wine Bar Beverage Menu, and partial brunch mentions. The frozen baseline reconciles with multiple exact or normalized current matches, but three baseline items are not present in the accessible current menu block and the current catalog has additional products. No complete restaurant-issued allergen or cross-contact disclosure was found; direct named ingredients support narrow positive allergen evidence only, with unavailable used for unestablished negatives.
